description: Language-neutral golden vectors for the tempo twin (pkg/hub/tempo <-> @alloy/sdk/tempo). Each case builds an instant from calendar components in a named zone, applies one operation, and renders the result as a string ('iso' -> UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds; 'date' -> YYYY-MM-DD). Covers DST-correct whole-unit calendar arithmetic (plan 007). Fractional-day additions and non-English-locale month parsing are deliberately EXCLUDED because they are TS-only capabilities the Go twin does not implement (see conformance/README.md). See conformance/README.md.

spring-forward: +24h is fixed elapsed time, NOT the same instant as +1 calendar day (plan 007)
fall-back: a calendar day keeps wall-clock midnight, so 25 real hours elapse (plan 007)

default month overflow: Jan 31 + 1 month rolls into March
month-end clamping: Jan 31 + 1 month clamps to Feb 29 (leap year)
